messages:
maya (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock the visibility/observability scope for the next release. Customer asks piled up: per-route cost breakdown, lightweight trace hooks, and an error analytics view that surfaces regression signals. Can we propose an MVP cut by EOD?

raj (Eng): Agree. My initial take: prioritize per-route cost card + error analytics (basic grouping + top stack frames). Trace hooks are higher engineering lift; can we make them opt-in v1 with a simple SDK shim?

tomas (SRE): +1 on opt-in trace hooks. We should avoid global sampling changes for launch. Suggest a small header we can read and attach span id server-side. Minimal footprint.

olivia (Design): Sketching a compact dashboard card that shows cost by route, p50/p95 latency, and error rate sparkline. Also a modal drilldown with top errors and an example request. Will post comps in #design in 30m. :paintbrush:

sasha (Data): For error analytics MVP I can produce: grouped stacktrace hash, count, last-seen, and a simple trend delta metric. Need ~2 days to bake ingestion and a rollup job.

maya (PM): Nice. Let's propose an MVP list: (1) Per-route cost card (token & infra cost estimate), (2) Error analytics table with grouping + trend, (3) Opt-in trace header shim + server-side span attach (no full traces). Launch criteria: data fidelity >= 95% for cost calc on synthetic workload, error grouping precision sanity check, UX flow validated with 2 pilot customers.

raj (Eng): Implementation notes: cost card requires joining request metadata with token counts — we have token counters in the dataplane but need backfill for last 7 days. I can add a short job to recompute aggregates. Trace shim: add header X-RI-TRACE and create a noop span if present. Code snippet for shim: ```python
# example shim
trace_id = request.headers.get('X-RI-TRACE')
if trace_id:
    tracer.start_span(trace_id)
```

ops-bot: New task created: PROD-4578 "Per-route cost aggregates" assigned to raj (Eng). Due 5 working days.

tomas (SRE): One caution on cost calc: cached/prefetching responses can skew token counts; we should document assumptions and add a correction factor for cached hits.

maya (PM): Good catch — add note to launch docs and to the cost card tooltip. Also want to prioritize customer validation: @olivia can you run a small prototype with ACME and Brightleaf (they asked specifically)?

olivia (Design): Yes, I'll schedule a design review and quick prototype session with ACME on Thursday. I'll bring a short usability script.

sasha (Data): Blocking: need access to request route tagging for older events. If entitlements prevent it, we'll scope to last 14 days only. Will update this thread by EOD.

raj (Eng): Feels doable for the sprint if we cut non-essential trace features. Proposed owner matrix: raj - cost card & shim, sasha - error grouping pipeline, olivia - UX + pilot, tomas - infra reliability gating, maya - PM / customer coordination.

maya (PM): Approved. Final asks before I raise in roadmap forum: define rollout phases (pilot -> gradual rollout -> GA), success metrics (adoption, error detection rate, cost accuracy), and known risks (sampling bias, cached skew). I'll draft the roadmap blurb and post in #product-roadmap by tomorrow. :spiral_calendar:

raj (Eng): Quick open question — do we want a beta flag in the Console UI for trace hook opt-in or rely on API header only? I'm leaning UI flag so customers can toggle without code change.

tomas (SRE): UI toggle is better ops-wise. We'll surface the flag in Dedicated + Hosted control planes. I'll add an ops checklist for rollout.

maya (PM): OK, include beta flag. Thanks everyone — I'll synthesize and post next steps.

olivia (Design): Posted preliminary comps in #design: https://redwood.design/proto/observability-cost-card — feedback welcome.
